meta.name: Ghost Hunters
meta.description:
Jason Hawes and his team of paranormal investigators, TAPS (The Atlantic Paranormal Society), cross the country searching for answers in the nation's most haunted locations.

Shows: Ghost Hunters: A Fright At The Opera, Ghost Hunters: There Ghosts The Neighborhood, Ghost Hunters: The Plot Thickens, Ghost Hunters: Fortress of Phantoms, Ghost Hunters: Houghton Hears A Who?
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus
